text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Admin time dropped, but not where we expected.** Reps saved the most time on CRM updates after calls, not on the notes themselves. About 40 minutes a day, back in their hands.

**2. Follow-ups got faster.** Emails went out the same day instead of two days later. Prospects noticed.

**3. Reps talked less.** Seeing their own talk-to-listen ratio changed behavior. Discovery calls improved without any extra coaching.

**4. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Asking permission upfront fixed it.

**5. Summaries still need a human.** Next steps were right most of the time. Pricing details were not.

Net result: we're keeping it, with guardrails.

What would you want to test next?

*(Synthetic scenario; figures are illustrative.)*
